title: Point-of-care ultrasound to evaluate volume status in congestive heart failure
description: Additional file 2: Video S2. Identification of the internal jugular vein (IJV) collapse point. The internal carotid artery can be seen deep to the IJV and its identity confirmed by its pulsatility. The identity of the IJV can also be confirmed by applying pressure to test for its collapsibility.
